name: native-build-responsiveness
goal: Native build evidence completes under Vitest without blocking worker communication, preserving all build, signing and fixture refusal assertions.

evidence: CI exact b0 ran all three native assertions successfully but its worker lost onTaskUpdate during synchronous builds; keep product checks and deadlines, let the test worker process events.

CI 39019622257 native-build fails closed on [vitest-worker] Timeout calling onTaskUpdate despite three passed native product tests. Saved immutable record/log in /tmp/harness-ci-b0-record-20261017/20261017090804876.
Wait for native subprocesses asynchronously while keeping the same timeout, output bound, exit semantics and three original product/signing assertions.

Actual verification wrapper passes all three unchanged native product assertions and stores native-build output plus assertion captures. Debug and Release signed ad hoc; fixture Release rejected; exit 0 without worker error.
